name: Deore XT pedal pair
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed left/right SPD pedal pair, cartridge-type Cro-Mo axles, double-sided binding and BC 9/16 × 20 TPI threads. The 1991 table gives 450 g for the pair; cleat inclusion is not specified.
